decks.notes: This deck focuses on quickly assembling the key combo pieces, Colossus Hammer and Sigarda's Aid, to equip a creature with a massive power boost and evasion. By using cards like Stoneforge Mystic to fetch equipment and Puresteel Paladin to lower equip costs, the deck aims to play aggressively and overwhelm opponents before they can react. The inclusion of efficient creatures like Ornithopter and Inkmoth Nexus further enhances the deck's speed and threat level. With proper sequencing and resource management, this deck can quickly close out games with a swift and decisive Hammer Time combo.

The deck utilizes equipment cards to quickly equip creatures, granting them powerful boosts in combat. It combines cost-reduction abilities with creature and equipment tutors to assemble a quick and lethal combo. The deck aims to flood the board with creatures and attach powerful equipment, such as Colossus Hammer, to create an incredibly strong and fast attacking force. The deck is designed to overwhelm opponents with powerful creatures and equipment combos, creating an aggressive and difficult-to-stop offense.

This aggro deck focuses on utilizing efficient removal spells and disruptive hand disruption to control the board while rapidly deploying threats such as Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Tarmogoyf. It also makes use of powerful planeswalkers like Wrenn and Six to generate incremental advantage and pressure the opponent. The inclusion of Mishra's Bauble and Urza's Saga helps to smooth out draws and provide additional value throughout the game. Overall, this Jund deck aims to apply early pressure, disrupt the opponent's game plan, and close out the game quickly.

The deck focuses on utilizing a mix of powerful aggressive creatures and efficient removal spells to maintain control of the board and deal damage to the opponent quickly. The inclusion of Jegantha as a companion allows for additional flexibility and consistency in casting spells. With a mix of early threats like Ragavan and Wild Nacatl, alongside larger creatures like Nishoba Brawler and Scion of Draco, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast-paced, aggressive strategy. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the wide range of colors necessary for the powerful spells in the deck.

This deck focuses on assembling the combo of equipping a Colossus Hammer or Kaldra Compleat to a creature with Puresteel Paladin or Sigarda's Aid to quickly deal lethal damage to the opponent. It utilizes efficient equipment tutors like Stoneforge Mystic and Steelshaper's Gift to find the necessary pieces. The deck also includes low-cost artifact creatures like Ornithopter and Memnite to enable fast starts and Inkmoth Nexus for additional threat. With this aggressive strategy, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with powerful, hard-to-interact-with threats before they can establish board control.

This deck focuses on playing low-cost spells and creatures to quickly put pressure on the opponent and disrupt their game plan. Mishra's Bauble and Consider help dig for key cards while Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Murktide Regent provide aggressive threats. Counterspells like Spell Pierce and Counterspell help protect your board while cards like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat provide additional removal. The deck aims to win quickly by overwhelming the opponent with efficient creatures and spells, while using disruption to control the tempo of the game.

The deck focuses on quick, aggressive plays utilizing powerful creature spells like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Seasoned Pyromancer to deal damage to the opponent quickly. It also incorporates disruptive elements such as Thoughtseize and Dauthi Voidwalker to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck aims to control the board using removal spells like Terminate and Lightning Bolt while also maintaining its own board presence. The addition of cards like Grief and Feign Death provide additional value and versatility in combat situations. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent through a combination of aggression and disruption.

This deck aims to utilize Indomitable Creativity to cheat out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and generate advantage with cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker. The deck also includes a control aspect with cards like Spell Pierce and Prismari Command to protect the combo pieces. Additionally, the deck includes a land toolbox with cards like Dwarven Mine and Ketria Triome to help fix mana and generate value. Overall, the deck focuses on creativity and explosive plays to overwhelm the opponent in a Modern 1 vs 1 format.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly assemble the combo of Puresteel Paladin, Sigarda's Aid, and Colossus Hammer to equip the hammer for free and swing for lethal infect damage with Inkmoth Nexus. The deck also utilizes cards like Stoneforge Mystic and Urza's Saga to efficiently search for combo pieces and equipment. The inclusion of protection cards like Giver of Runes and Spell Pierce helps to protect your key creatures and spells, while cards like Shadowspear and Nettlecyst provide additional utility and power to your creatures.

The main concept of this deck is to aggressively cast Cascade spells to overwhelm the opponent while disrupting their game plan. By utilizing cards like Violent Outburst and Shardless Agent to trigger Cascade, the deck aims to cast powerful cards like Crashing Footfalls and Fury for free. Additionally, the inclusion of disruptive spells like Blood Moon and Force of Negation helps control the game and protect the deck's powerful threats. The mana base is optimized to support Cascade spells and ensure consistent casting of the deck's key cards.

The deck focuses on quickly deploying threats and disrupting the opponent's game plan with efficient spells like Lightning Bolt and Counterspell. Mishra's Bauble helps to filter draws and trigger prowess abilities on creatures like Dragon's Rage Channeler. Murktide Regent and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer provide powerful threats that can quickly close out the game. The mana base is optimized for consistency and allows for the deck to maintain aggression. Overall, the deck aims to apply pressure and control the game through a mix of efficient creatures and versatile spells in a Modern 1 vs 1 setting.
